target.title: fix(session-fork): add timeout to parent-fork token count resolution (#101718)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`resolveParentForkTokenCount` reads the parent session transcript file to estimate token count when forking a session, but has no timeout. On large transcripts (hundreds of MB) or slow filesystems (NFS, FUSE), this blocks session creation indefinitely, accumulating blocked async contexts that exhaust gateway connection slots (#101718).

## Why This Change Was Made

A 2-second `Promise.race` timeout is added in `resolveParentForkTokenCount`. On timeout, it returns `undefined` — the same sentinel the normal fallback path already produces. `resolveParentForkDecision` already handles `undefined` correctly: returns `{status: "fork"}` without a `parentTokens` estimate.

The existing fast paths (`resolveFreshSessionTotalTokens`, `cachedTokens`) are synchronous and complete before the timeout can fire. The timeout only guards the slow filesystem probe (`fs.stat` + transcript read up to 1MB).

Risk note: this touches the session-fork path used by gateway session creation and reply subagent spawn. The timeout default (allow fork without token estimate) is the safe choice vs blocking indefinitely.

## Evidence

### Layer 1 — 实机行为（聚焦测试终端输出）

```
 ✓ forkSessionEntryFromParent > forks transcripts in the directory for the store being mutated  165ms
 ✓ resolveParentForkDecision > returns fork with token count when the runtime resolves quickly    1ms
 ✓ resolveParentForkDecision > returns fork without parentTokens when the runtime hangs (timeout) 2008ms
 ✓ resolveParentForkDecision > returns skip when parent is too large                              1ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
```

The timeout test took exactly 2008ms, confirming the 2-second deadline fires and fork proceeds without blocking.

### Layer 2 — 相关测试套件

```
pnpm test src/auto-reply/reply/session-fork.test.ts         → 4 passed ✓
pnpm test src/auto-reply/reply/session-fork.runtime.test.ts → (existing tests) ✓
pnpm test src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts -t "fork"    → (existing tests) ✓
```

### Layer 3 — 静态检查

```
$ pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/auto-reply/reply/session-fork.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session-fork.test.ts
Checking formatting...
All matched files use the correct format.
Finished in 82ms on 2 files using 1 threads.
```

### Changes

| File | + | - | Net |
|------|---|---|-----|
| `src/auto-reply/reply/session-fork.ts` | +7 | -1 | +6 |
| `src/auto-reply/reply/session-fork.test.ts` | +50 | -1 | +49 |

Closes #101718.
